notes: DCA 6-2015 Table B2 (p. B4), Post Heights Based on Tributary Area for Center Posts, under the Connecticut 2022 pack. Each hand-authored expectation was read from the page (PDF sha256 205d57b5...3009e), not exported from the pack: the per-row cases were written from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout, pp. B3-B5), while the pack's rows were typed from the page rendered at 500 dpi, so this file cross-checks the two readings. Per row one case, cycling: a centre post under a continuous beam asked at 4/5 of the row's band, so note 4's x 1.25 lands exactly on it; the same 3 sq ft less (x 1.25, 3 3/4 sq ft inside); or a spliced beam, not multiplied, 5 sq ft inside the band. The post height at the printed height, 6" under or 1" over (short); a row printed NP expects out of scope, NP. Then the worked example, a case per guide scope limit, the inputs the scope and table ask for, and the column refusals. The generated cases are GoldenRunner.DeckBoundaries' output, committed.
